bathAction.title: Wash horns
bathAction.tooltip: Run water along the horns, into every ridge.

description.text: [npc.Name] [npc.verb(run)] a wet hand along [npc.her] [npc.horns], into every ridge and around the base where sweat collects. The water darkens what was dull, then [npc.she] [npc.verb(rinse)] them until they shine. [npc.speech(The base always holds it. Right in the groove.)]

[npc.Name] [npc.verb(lean)] into [npc.her] own hand and [npc.verb(stroke)] [npc.her] [npc.horns] under the hot water, slow, like [npc.she] [npc.verb(like)] the feel of it. A little [npc.moan] slips out when [npc.her] fingers find a sensitive ridge. [npc.speech(Mmm. Do not rush the ridges. That feels good.)]

[npc.Name] [npc.verb(scrub)] along [npc.her] [npc.horns] with a rough palm, knocking the dirt out of the grooves, then [npc.verb(rinse)] them in one hard pass. [npc.speech(They are clean. Stop fussing over them.)]
